pass_max_days.description: Maximum number of days a password may be used before it must be changed. Set to 0 to disable expiration.

pass_min_days.description: Minimum number of days between password changes. Prevents immediate password re-use.

pass_warn_age.description: Number of days before password expiration to warn the user.

mail_dir.description: Directory where user mailboxes are stored.

uid_min.description: First regular user UID (non-system accounts). System accounts get UIDs below this.

uid_max.description: Last regular user UID. User IDs beyond this may be reserved for special uses.

gid_min.description: First regular group GID (non-system groups). System groups get GIDs below this.

sub_uid_min.description: First subordinate UID for user namespace.

sub_uid_max.description: Last subordinate UID for user namespace.

sub_uid_count.description: Number of subordinate UIDs per user.

sub_gid_min.description: First subordinate GID for user namespace.

sub_gid_max.description: Last subordinate GID for user namespace.

sub_gid_count.description: Number of subordinate GIDs per user.

login_retries.description: Maximum number of login retries before aborting.

chfn_restrict.description: Fields a regular user may change via chfn(1): 'f' (full name), 'r' (room), 'w' (work phone), 'h' (home phone).

encrypt_method.description: Password hashing algorithm (YESCRYPT, BCRYPT, SHA512, SHA256, MD5, or DES). YESCRYPT recommended.

usergroups_enab.description: If true, creates a group for the user with the same name as the user account.
